items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I was impressed also by a fellow named Bob Shafner Staffner

ctx.x: In your career, what did you want to be in those days? Did you want to be another Louis Armstrong, or did you --
Well, after hearing Louis Armstrong, and Freddie Keppard Gebhardt, and then I heard -- I was impressed also by a fellow named Bob Shafner Staffner --
Who replaced Louis with King Oliver,
